Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Hybrid cache cooperative connector - pilot proposal & mutual action plan

Hi Samir, Nadia —

Following up from last week's partner sync: we sketched a short pilot to validate a cooperative caching model between Pinecone and a customer S3 cold lane (Acme Data in this thread). The idea is to prototype a connector that surfaces Pinecone cold-miss telemetry back to a shared prefetch layer in S3 so that downstream retrievals get ~50-70% fewer cold fetches during replays and peak queries.

Why this matters: Redwood customers with large cold stores are seeing spikes in token costs and 200–600ms cold-read variance that hits tail latency. If Pinecone can signal candidates (ids + recency score) and we can proactively populate an S3-backed compact snapshot, we think we can reduce both API calls and egress while preserving retrieval quality.

Proposed MVP (attached 'pilot-mvp-scope.xlsx'):
- Lightweight connector (Python lambda) that listens to Pinecone cold-miss webhook + periodic snapshotter to S3
- TTL & recency policy: Redwood suggests 48h sliding window + top-K per namespace
- Success metrics: 50% reduction in cold calls, <5% quality delta (recall@k) on our eval prompts, 20% unit-cost reduction on queries for pilot accounts
- Duration: 8 weeks (2w design + 4w implementation + 2w validation)

Asks:
1) Samir — can Pinecone expose a per-namespace cold-miss webhook (or a lightweight export) that includes vector ids, timestamps, and a simple recency score?
2) Nadia — will Acme be comfortable with a short-term S3 prefetch policy and share permissioned test data for the pilot environment?
3) Vanessa/Laura — can your teams slot an engineering lead and an SRE on the 2-8 Aug sprint window?

Attached: redwood-pinecone-cachecoop-arch-draft.pdf (high-level flow), pilot-mvp-scope.xlsx (scope & metrics).

Thanks — keen to align on next steps and a mutual action plan.

Ben Carter

Subject: Re: Hybrid cache cooperative connector - pilot proposal & mutual action plan

Thanks Ben — good summary. I'm into validating this model; we have a few follow-ups from the Pinecone side before we commit engineering cycles: 

1) Telemetry: we can emit a compact cold-miss export (JSONL) with vector_id, namespace, score, and event_ts. It won't be a push webhook initially (we're pushing a new internal exporter next quarter) — for the pilot we can provide an S3-ready export delivered every 15 minutes. Is that acceptable?

2) Security: we need an outline for access controls if Pinecone exports into a Redwood-managed S3 bucket vs. us writing to an Acme bucket. We prefer writing to an Acme bucket or a mutually managed bucket to avoid cross-account credentials.

3) Scale and sampling: for large namespaces we'll need a sampling policy. Can Redwood's snapshotter accept a configurable sampling rate and provide deterministic hashing for repeatability?

Next steps I propose:
- Tech sync (30m) to agree export schema and sampling. I can do Tue 03 Jul 09:00-11:00 PT or Wed 04 Jul 14:00-16:00 PT.
- Pinecone will prepare a 2-day export (sample) and an internal runbook that explains any edge cases (deleted ids, namespace renames).

Attached: short export spec (we included a stub below). Also linking a quick design doc: https://pinecone.io/docs/cache-coop-stub (internal).

Samir Shah

Hi all — appreciate the clear ask. Acme is open to participating in a short pilot under two commercial/ops conditions:

1) Procurement: we'll need a short MSA addendum + a PO template — I attached our standard PO template and noted required fields. We can process a pilot PO within 7 business days once legal has the addendum.

2) Data handling: we require that the prefetch snapshots are written into our account bucket (acme-prod-test) and Redwood provides an audit log of any snapshot writes. We cannot accept third-party writes into our primary buckets.

Operationally: agree to the 8-week timeline, but we will treat weeks 3–6 as implementation with a hard freeze for production-like validation in week 7. We also need to nominate an Acme infra owner (cc'd pt-infra) who will coordinate cross-account access and KMS allowances.

I'll join Samir for the tech sync on Tue 03 Jul at 10:00 PT (works for me). Ben — please send a short MAP (mutual action plan) after the sync with owners and dates so my procurement and infra queues can align.

Best,
